name: aws-security-analyzer
description: Run a consolidated AWS security posture scan from your IDE — Trusted Advisor security findings plus a curated set of IAM, EC2/network, S3, RDS, KMS, container, detective-control, IAM Access Analyzer external-access, and Compute Optimizer best-practice checks — enriched with Well-Architected Security Pillar guidance, IAM deep-analysis, and AWS Documentation references — powered by four MCP servers, emitting a consolidated JSON + HTML report.
